text: Implemented typed VoxelDomain plus VoxelSelection.AllSpatial. Backends now resolve default reads against their readable voxelDomain: dense/file/archive use full spatial domains; LatentResponseDatasetBackend uses active mask voxels and preserves global voxel indices. Added shared regression tests for dense full-domain defaults, masked latent active defaults, and explicit full-spatial rejection. Verified with sbt datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test: JVM 27 passed, JS 16 passed.
